title: Long Pressed Name
statement: Return true if typed can be produced from name by long-pressing some characters, causing repeated characters in typed.

title: Long Pressed Name
statement: Return true if typed can be produced from name by long-pressing some characters, causing repeated characters in typed.
code: class Solution { public boolean isLongPressedName(String name,String typed){int i=0,j=0;while(j<typed.length()){if(i<name.length()&&name.charAt(i)==typed.charAt(j)){i++;j++;}else if(j>0&&typed.charAt(j)==typed.charAt(j-1))j++;else return false;}return i==name.length();} }

title: Unique Email Addresses
statement: Count unique email addresses after ignoring dots and everything after + in each local part; domains remain unchanged.

title: Unique Email Addresses
statement: Count unique email addresses after ignoring dots and everything after + in each local part; domains remain unchanged.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int numUniqueEmails(String[] emails){Set<String>s=new HashSet<>();for(String e:emails){String[]p=e.split("@",2);String local=p[0].split("\\+",2)[0].replace(".","");s.add(local+"@"+p[1]);}return s.size();} }

title: Number of Recent Calls
statement: Implement RecentCounter.ping(t), returning the number of calls in the inclusive interval [t-3000,t].

title: Number of Recent Calls
statement: Implement RecentCounter.ping(t), returning the number of calls in the inclusive interval [t-3000,t].
code:
import java.util.*;
class RecentCounter {Queue<Integer>q=new ArrayDeque<>();public RecentCounter(){}public int ping(int t){q.add(t);while(q.peek()<t-3000)q.remove();return q.size();}}

title: Reorder Data in Log Files
statement: Place all letter logs before digit logs; sort letter logs by content then identifier, while keeping digit logs in original order.

title: Reorder Data in Log Files
statement: Place all letter logs before digit logs; sort letter logs by content then identifier, while keeping digit logs in original order.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public String[] reorderLogFiles(String[] logs){List<String>letters=new ArrayList<>(),digits=new ArrayList<>();for(String x:logs){String rest=x.substring(x.indexOf(' ')+1);if(Character.isDigit(rest.charAt(0)))digits.add(x);else letters.add(x);}letters.sort((a,b)->{String ar=a.substring(a.indexOf(' ')+1),br=b.substring(b.indexOf(' ')+1);int c=ar.compareTo(br);return c!=0?c:a.substring(0,a.indexOf(' ')).compareTo(b.substring(0,b.indexOf(' ')));});letters.addAll(digits);return letters.toArray(new String[0]);} }

statement: Return the sum of node values in a BST that lie in the inclusive range [low, high].

title: Range Sum of BST
statement: Return the sum of node values in a BST that lie in the inclusive range [low, high].
code: class Solution { public int rangeSumBST(TreeNode root,int low,int high){if(root==null)return 0;int total=root.val>=low&&root.val<=high?root.val:0;if(root.val>low)total+=rangeSumBST(root.left,low,high);if(root.val<high)total+=rangeSumBST(root.right,low,high);return total;} }

title: Valid Mountain Array
statement: Return true if an array strictly increases to one peak and then strictly decreases, with both sides non-empty.
code: class Solution { public boolean validMountainArray(int[] a){int n=a.length,i=0;while(i+1<n&&a[i]<a[i+1])i++;if(i==0||i==n-1)return false;while(i+1<n&&a[i]>a[i+1])i++;return i==n-1;} }

title: Delete Columns to Make Sorted
statement: Count columns that are not sorted in nondecreasing order from the first row to the last row.
approach_name: Check each column top to bottom
code: class Solution { public int minDeletionSize(String[] strs){if(strs.length==0)return 0;int ans=0;for(int c=0;c<strs[0].length();c++)for(int r=1;r<strs.length;r++)if(strs[r].charAt(c)<strs[r-1].charAt(c)){ans++;break;}return ans;} }

title: Verifying an Alien Dictionary
statement: Return true if the list of words is sorted according to a supplied alien alphabet order.
approach_name: Compare adjacent words by custom ranks

title: Verifying an Alien Dictionary
statement: Return true if the list of words is sorted according to a supplied alien alphabet order.
approach_name: Compare adjacent words by custom ranks
code: class Solution { public boolean isAlienSorted(String[] words,String order){int[]rank=new int[26];for(int i=0;i<order.length();i++)rank[order.charAt(i)-'a']=i;for(int i=1;i<words.length;i++){String a=words[i-1],b=words[i];int j=0;while(j<a.length()&&j<b.length()&&a.charAt(j)==b.charAt(j))j++;if(j==b.length()&&a.length()>b.length())return false;if(j<a.length()&&j<b.length()&&rank[a.charAt(j)-'a']>rank[b.charAt(j)-'a'])return false;}return true;} }

code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int repeatedNTimes(int[] nums){Set<Integer>s=new HashSet<>();for(int x:nums)if(!s.add(x))return x;return -1;} }

title: Univalued Binary Tree
statement: Return true if every node in a binary tree has the same value.
approach_name: Check every node against the root value
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public boolean isUnivalTree(TreeNode root){if(root==null)return true;ArrayDeque<TreeNode>q=new ArrayDeque<>();q.push(root);while(!q.isEmpty()){TreeNode n=q.pop();if(n.val!=root.val)return false;if(n.left!=null)q.push(n.left);if(n.right!=null)q.push(n.right);}return true;} }
